title: Section 23 ICA — Lawful consideration and object

content.overview: The consideration or object of an agreement is lawful unless forbidden by law, defeats any law, is fraudulent, involves injury to person or property, or is immoral or opposed to public policy. Unlawful consideration or object makes the agreement void.

sections.heading: Forbidden and defeating law
sections.body: Agreements to do what statute forbids, or that defeat mandatory provisions, fail under s. 23.

sections.heading: Public policy
sections.body: A narrow head — restraint of trade (s. 27) and established categories. Do not invent new public-policy heads without authority.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Identify the exact prohibition. Analyse severance and restitution carefully where illegality is partial.
